_comment: Hypothesis test: SVS MaxPipelineSize=1 (fully serial) on rocketfuel_1755 at bw=10 Mbps. Baseline has pipeline=20 and sub-linear FIB. Pipeline=1 eliminates Interest bursts entirely — if congestion is driven by parallel fetching, FIB should converge perfectly. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_onephase_pipeline1_3stage
name: rocketfuel_1755_onephase_p0to2000by2000_pipeline1
description: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at bw=10 Mbps with SVS pipeline=1 (serial fetch). Eliminates Interest burst; tests whether MaxPipelineSize alone causes congestion-driven FIB sub-linearity.

jobs.name: stage1: DV convergence snapshot (onephase, 0 prefixes, bw=10)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p0 (import DV snap, bw=10, pipeline=1)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p2000 (import DV snap, bw=10, pipeline=1)
